measure_description: Measured with utils/measure script (v0.6.0:cli) using a resistive dummy load attached in parallel, because the power meter reads a flat 0.00W below roughly 1W without it. Dummy load: 25W incandescent bulb, calibrated at 2239 ohm (~24W draw). This replaces an earlier run that used a 60W/923 ohm dummy load; the smaller load reduces the error introduced by subtracting the dummy-load consumption from the combined reading.
name: REGELLO-Z Mirror Light (600mm)
